name: executable-specification-language
description: A compiler for readable executable software specifications.

scripts.build: npm run grammar:generate && npm run java:build && npm run kotlin:build && npm run python:build && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && rolldown -c
scripts.test:package: npm run build && vitest run --config vitest.package.config.ts
scripts.test:java-package: npm run build && vitest run --config vitest.java-package.config.ts
scripts.test:kotlin-package: npm run build && vitest run --config vitest.kotlin-package.config.ts
scripts.test:pilot: npm run build && vitest run --config vitest.pilot.config.ts
scripts.dev: npm run grammar:generate && npm run test:watch
scripts.check: npm run grammar:generate && npm run java:build && npm run kotlin:build && npm run python:build && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run test:acceptance && npm run build
scripts.check:core: npm run grammar:generate && npm run java:build && npm run kotlin:build && npm run python:build && npm run typecheck && vitest run --config vitest.core.config.ts test/unit && vitest run --config vitest.core.config.ts test/acceptance --maxWorkers=2 && npm run build
